name: bottle-supervision
description: Bottle production supervision — event-driven demo (Kafka, TypeScript)

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n tracker,detector,cap,label,shape,automation -c cyan,magenta,yellow,yellow,yellow,green "npm run tracker" "npm run detector" "npm run analyzer-cap" "npm run analyzer-label" "npm run analyzer-shape" "npm run automation"
scripts.debug: concurrently -n tracker,detector,cap,label,shape,automation -c cyan,magenta,yellow,yellow,yellow,green "tsx --inspect=9229 src/bottle-tracking/main.ts" "tsx --inspect=9230 src/detector/main.ts" "tsx --inspect=9231 src/analyzer-cap/main.ts" "tsx --inspect=9232 src/analyzer-label/main.ts" "tsx --inspect=9233 src/analyzer-shape/main.ts" "tsx --inspect=9234 src/automation/main.ts"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n tracker,detector,cap,label,shape,automation -c cyan,magenta,yellow,yellow,yellow,green "npm run dev:tracker" "npm run dev:detector" "npm run dev:analyzer-cap" "npm run dev:analyzer-label" "npm run dev:analyzer-shape" "npm run dev:automation"
